Whoa! What are these guys doing here?
Oh, Pelulu.\nWelcome to the world of sakura!
What is this?\nA hanami gathering?
No, they're not here for hanami...
Thank you everyone for gathering here today!
The sakura world has fought off many formidable\nenemies, but the attack on Celesa's tree is still\nfresh in our minds.
So we have decided to recruit warriors from the\nsakura world to protect Celesa's tree...I'm glad\nthat many people are interested in it.
That's what's happening right now!
I thank you all from the bottom of my heart.\nAll the people who have gathered here today will\nbe sakura warri...
Waitttttt!!
C-Caylass?! I can't believe all those boozes and\nfences for keeping wild animals out aren't enough\nto stop you...!
I knew you'd eventually break through them, but I\ndidn't expect that you could do it in such a\nshort time...!
Oh? So It was you guys?\nI thought you prepared the boozes and fences for\nme to smash in one blow to brighten up my mood.
I don't get it, why did you guys want to stop her?\nI don't think she'd do anything bad though.
Yeah, but...
We thought she'd definitely want to get involved\nand mess up everything if she knew we were going\nto recruit warriors to protect Celesa's tree.
What?! Why would I mess up everything? To begin\nwith, this sakura world is made up of 2 zones,\nthe daylight zone, Dia, and the night zone, Noche!
I came because it has a lot to do with me.\nI care about this sakura world...!
See, she's an airhead.
Ignorant with a bad attitude...
Anyway, I've come to see the warrior who will be\nprotecting the day region of the sakura world\nmyself.
Err...Caylass?\nWe were going to accept everyone this time though.
Don't be naive! There are certain qualities a\nwarrior needs to have to protect and fight for\nthis sakura world!
You over there!\nWhat can you do?!
Oh, me?\nI'm good at running.
What about you?!
I, I can swim!
And that big guy over there, yes you!\nWhat are you good at?!
Me?\nBesides this sword, I'm good at climbing trees.
You gotta be kidding me!! Running, swimming, and\nclimbing trees? How are you gonna protect Celesa's\ntree from the enemies with those?!
Hmm...that's kinda harsh, but what she's saying is\nnot wrong.
That's weird...\nCaylass usually only talks nonsense, doesn't she?
You mean she's a fake?!\nT-then where is the real Caylass?!
I understand your doubts, but the Caylass you see\nnow is the real Caylass.
So Caylass, what are you going to do?
Isn't it obvious? We can't just accept everyone so\neasily. We should make them compete with one\nanother and eliminate the weak ones!
I want y'all to run to the top of Mt. Sakuraten!\nOnly those who get there fast will be recognized\nas warriors!
They only need to be fast?
That's all?
So I just need to be fast, right?\nIn that case, I'm confident about my running\nability...
You think this is a joke?! This isn't some kind of\nleisurely walk with your friends, you know!!\nBecoming a sakura warrior isn't that simple!
Of course you need to be kicking people's ass and\nshow us your strength! You need to aim for the top\nof Mt. Sakuraten while fighting the others!
Of course not!\nThey need to be kicking people's ass and win to\nshow us their strength!
Y'all are going to be heading to the top of\nMt. Sakuraten and knocking down anyone who stands\nin your way!
Well, that sounds troublesome, plus...\nIt has nothing to do with us.\nI have a bad feeling about this, we'll just leave.
You can't just play possum after hearing all this.\nBesides, this adventurer's ability can become a\ngood benchmark to measure their ability.
But we're only here for hanami, not for a running\ntraining that includes fighting.
Um, Caylass, these people are from another w...
Please, do us a favor!
Yes, please. Because we think we'll be fine no\nmatter what happens as long as you're with us.
Hmm, but still...\nI feel like I don't wanna get involved this time.
Who knows Caylass may give you something as a\nreward if you make it to the top...
What?! Really?! Will she give us a treasure?!\nOr something unique and rare from this\nsakura world?!
Oh, I can tell that you feel like doing it now!\nRight, I prolly should reward you with something!
Fine!\nI'll reward those who make it to the top!
Keep your word! It's a promise!\nWell then, you should get ready too now!
Now, I'll announce the sakura warrior who will\nprotect Celesa's tree! The first place goes to\nBaavgai! Congratulations!
Baavgai had demonstrated a brilliant fighting\nstyle! Although he's a dual wielder, he makes use\nof his own physical strength in his attacks!
His spirit tells us that he would do anything to\nprotect the sakura tree. Yes, that's what makes a\ngood warrior!
Now you know what you're lacking!\nThat's strength! A weakling will never get to be a\nsakura warrior!
And coming in second place is this adventurer!\nThe girl who finished third also reached the top\nwith great determination. I like the spirit!
Well, I don't care as long as I get the treasure.\nI hope you haven't forgot about the reward!
Right, Caylass.\nYou should hand them their reward...
Oh, thank you! Here, take your reward!
Alright, niceee!!\nUh...? What's this? What did you give me?
Uh? Oh, it's the booze from the Lush Falls in the\nnight sakura world, remember? It would be the best\ndrink to enjoy for hanami.
What?! But wasn't it the booze that made that\nweird sword drunk and turn violent? Besides, you\nonly gave me 1 bottle, that's like nothing...
We're really really sorry for troubling you again\nthis time.
We look forward to seeing you again...
Hi, adventurer!
Oh, what brings you here?
We came because we just realized that we forgot to\ndo the actual hanami because of the sudden battle\nyou dragged us into.
That's strange.
The occasion to gather those who wish to protect\nCelesa's tree had suddenly turned into a ritual\nperformed by some kind of barbarian tribe.
Well, anyway you came at the right time!
??\nDid something happen?
Actually Baavgai who has officially become a\nsakura warrior has gone to Mt. Sakuraten and has\nnot come back...
Oh, no wonder I don't see him.\nWhat made him go there?
I have no idea and as I was thinking about it,\nyou guys came.
Since you competed together to become a sakura\nwarrior, could you go and ask him?
Huh...?\nBut we came here for hanami.
I'm very sorry, but...\nIf you can go and ask Baavgai, I'll prepare some\nrewards for you.
I guess we have no choice.\nFine then, let's go now!
Oh, that girl...\nShe only moves if she knows there's a reward.
That means it's easy to get her to work.\nIsn't it a good thing?\nLet's just wait for them!
Thanks for agreeing to be my opponent for the sake\nof my Ingrizzible Dual Swords!
Now I can protect Celesa's tree and do my job as\na sakura warrior without any worries.
Oh, I'm sorry for getting you into trouble again\nthis time.
My goodness!
Please control your behavior a little bit!
Hey!\nWhy do I feel like you're kinda mean to me?!
Thank you very much for everything.\nPlease take this!
Next time please take your time to enjoy the\nhanami!
Right, next time for sure...\nWait, I think you said the same thing too last\ntime.
Well, so long and see you around...
We look forward to seeing you again...
